messages.message: TypeScript will only remove the inline type specifiers which will leave behind a side effect import at runtime. Convert this to a top-level type qualifier to properly remove the entire import.

cases.code: import { type A as AA } from 'mod';

messages.message: TypeScript will only remove the inline type specifiers which will leave behind a side effect import at runtime. Convert this to a top-level type qualifier to properly remove the entire import.

cases.output: import type { A as AA } from 'mod';
